Mr. Sushil Kumar, Advocate, holding

Advocate for the appellant.
Mr. K.N. Joshi, Deputy Advocate 
General for the State of Uttarakhand.
In ground No.-J in the Memo of 
Appeal, it has been mentioned that 
appellant had earlier filed Writ Petition 
No. 756 of 1993 before High Court of 
Judicature at Allahabad. However, result 
of the said writ petition has not been 
indicated.
In such view of the matter, learned 
counsel for the appellant is directed to 
get copy of the order passed in the said 
writ petition.
List this case in the week 
commencing 18.04.2022.
(R.C. Khulbe, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
